mentions.name: Untether Notes
mentions.description: Garmin watch app that captures voice notes via the paired phone's microphone and automatically transcribes them on the watch. Part of an offline, privacy-first suite that adds smartwatch functionality without cloud services; currently in beta.
mentions.problem: Watch built-in keyboards are tough to use for taking notes.
mentions.audience: Garmin smartwatch users who want to reduce phone screentime while keeping essential functionality
